info.title: MarketBox 2.0 Open API
info.description: The MarketBox public API. Use this API to manage bookings, orders, service offerings, and suppliers across your MarketBox projects. All endpoints are versioned under `/v1` and authenticated with an API key in the `x-api-key` header.

ApiKeyAuth.name: x-api-key
ApiKeyAuth.description: API key minted in the MarketBox dashboard. Scope is restricted to the projects you select at creation time.

post.summary: Onboard the authenticated client to a project
post.description: Idempotently registers the signed-in end user as a CLIENT of the project: ensures a ProjectUsers membership, creates a Stripe customer on the project's connected account (when Stripe is configured), and writes the ClientProfile. Requires both an API key (`x-api-key`) and a client user JWT (`Authorization: Bearer`). Returns 201 on first onboarding, 200 if the client was already onboarded.

403.description: No access to project or unregistered user

get.summary: Get the authenticated client's package credits
get.description: Returns the signed-in client's remaining package credits on the project. Each entry is a PACKAGE order item the client owns; `quantityRemaining` is the live, authoritative balance. Only PAID orders count, and expired or fully-drawn-down packages are omitted (pass `includeExpired=true` to keep expired ones). Requires both an API key (`x-api-key`) and a client user JWT (`Authorization: Bearer`).
